questions.prompt: Which continent is United Arab Emirates in?

hints.nudge: A continent is one of the great land masses of the world. Find United Arab Emirates on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.
hints.whereToLook: Find United Arab Emirates on the Atlas and see which land mass it sits on.

questions.proof: United Arab Emirates is in Asia.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with United Arab Emirates?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture United Arab Emirates on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the United Arab Emirates article.

questions.proof: It borders Oman, Qatar, and Saudi Arabia.

questions.prompt: Which country has the capital city Abu Dhabi?

hints.nudge: Every country has one capital city. Find the city in the question on a map, then see which country it sits in.
hints.whereToLook: Look on the Atlas: find the city, then see which country it sits in.

questions.proof: The capital city of United Arab Emirates is Abu Dhabi.

questions.prompt: What is the capital city of United Arab Emirates?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the United Arab Emirates article.

questions.proof: The capital is Abu Dhabi, and the largest city is Dubai.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries covers the most ground?

hints.nudge: Area is how much ground a country covers, not how many people live there. A small crowded country can still be small.
hints.whereToLook: Compare the four on the Atlas. Area means how much ground a country covers.

questions.proof: By area: United Arab Emirates about 83,600 square kilometres; Armenia about 29,743 square kilometres; Kuwait about 17,818 square kilometres; Palestine about 6,020 square kilometres.

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia: United Arab Emirates
